description: The line plot illustrates the relationship between the loss ratio (in percentage) and the number of TeraFLOPs (TFLOPs) for different models, with the x-axis representing TFLOPs on a logarithmic scale ranging from 1e7 to 9e8, and the y-axis showing the loss ratio from 95% to 100%. The plot includes five distinct lines: a purple line with triangle markers labeled "Vanilla," an orange line with square markers labeled "SepLLM (n=64)," a blue line with cross markers labeled "SepLLM (n=128)," a green line with diamond markers labeled "SepLLM (n=64, H)," and a red line with circle markers labeled "SepLLM (n=64, H/T)." The "Vanilla" model maintains a loss ratio of approximately 100% across all TFLOP values. The "SepLLM (n=64)" model starts at a loss ratio of about 98% at 1e7 TFLOPs and increases to around 100% at 9e8 TFLOPs. The "SepLLM (n=128)" model begins at approximately 97% at 1e7 TFLOPs and rises to about 99.8% at 9e8 TFLOPs. The "SepLLM (n=64, H)" model starts at roughly 97.5% at 1e7 TFLOPs and increases to approximately 99.9% at 9e8 TFLOPs. The "SepLLM (n=64, H/T)" model begins at 95% at 1e7 TFLOPs and rises to about 98.8% at 9e8 TFLOPs. All models show an increasing trend in loss ratio as the number of TFLOPs increases, with the "Vanilla" model consistently having the highest loss ratio.
